'''Delva Racine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] fashion designer and [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] socialite [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="DB" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DB" /> A challenging designer,<ref name="SithSnap">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/08/sithsnap20050811.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: A Nose for Fashion}}</ref> she specialized in outrageous ensembles that incorporated inspirations from [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim territories]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="DB" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Episode 3" /> Racine introduced her [[Summer/Legends|summer]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] collection and it was uniformly panned by the the media.<ref name="DB" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Racine, who had by then released another collection,<ref name="SithSnap" /> visited the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="DB3">{{DB|character|acros_krik|Acros-Krik}}</ref> She walked up the opera house's stairs with a Human as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Episode 3" /> Racine had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] kept in two buns on the sides of her head.<ref name="DB" /> At the opera house, she wore [[Goggles/Legends|googles]], a brown [[Clothing/Legends|neckpiece]] with a horn-like mask, armbands with silver tassels, a light beige tunic, a brown belt, a skirt of silver tassels, and sliver heels.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|73|Racine, Delva}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Delva Racine first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode 3" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Racine was played by real-life British fashion designer [[Alice Shreeve]], who is the creative director of the London-based women's wear label [https://www.belleandbunty.co.uk Belle & Bunty].<ref name="LifestyleTails">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lifestyletails.com/alice-shreeve-belle-and-bunty|text=Alice Shreeve and Pearl the Boston Terrier|author=Glazin, Simon|partialdate=2019|work=[http://www.lifestyletails.com Lifestyle Tails]|archivedate=20190405220402}}</ref> Concept art of the character was drawn by artist [[Sang Jun Lee]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>  The opera steps scene  including Shreeve, who was uncredited,<ref name="Episode 3" /> was filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Before Episode III's release, Racine was revealed in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published before the film's release on [[April 2]], 2005.<ref name="Visual Dictionary Amazon">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref>
